title: Chart rendering broken on staging after recent deploy
body:
## Bug: Chart Rendering Issue on Dashboard

### Description
The analytics charts aren't rendering properly after the recent update to staging. Getting WebGL context errors.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Navigate to /dashboard/analytics
2. Select any date range > 30 days
3. Charts fail to render
4. Console shows: `WebGL: CONTEXT_LOST_WEBGL`

### Expected Behavior
Charts should render with the selected data.

### Environment
- Browser: Chrome 120.0.6099.129
- OS: macOS 14.2.1
- Running locally via `docker compose up`

### Screenshots
![chart_error](https://placeholder.com/chart_error.png)

This is blocking our QA testing. Please advise on timeline for a fix.

comments.body: Looking into this. The WebGL issue is caused by the analytics endpoint returning too many data points for large date ranges. I've merged PR #27 to main with a server-side aggregation fix - just needs to deploy main to staging to verify the fix.

@alex-rivera Thanks for the quick analysis! I tested PR #27 locally and confirmed it fixes the aggregation issue.
